_review: Stage titles and descriptions drafted for the v2 home page from the four service pillar descriptions in src/data/services-section.json. Confirm wording before launch.
heading: Four stages, in order
subtitle: Assessment feeds defence, defence feeds evidence, and evidence keeps the posture from drifting back.

steps.title: Assess
steps.description: Penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, red teaming, and source code review establish where you actually stand.

steps.title: Defend
steps.description: Network security, SOC operations, SIEM, and incident response close what the assessment found and catch what comes next.

steps.title: Comply
steps.description: Findings map to ISO 27001, PCI, SOC 2, CBE, SAMA, and NCA evidence, so audits draw on work you have already done.

steps.title: Manage
steps.description: Retests, continuous monitoring, and awareness training keep the posture from slipping back between engagements.
